title: Cloud target seed: build the snapshot under the container CARGO_HOME; the fingerprint hashes the registry source path
goal: Registry units are fingerprinted with the absolute path of their source under CARGO_HOME, so a snapshot built under /home/runner/.cargo never matches a container whose CARGO_HOME is /root/.cargo. Build with CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo, correct the earlier CARGO_INCREMENTAL diagnosis in the docs, republish and re-measure
